messages.subject: Color %
parts:
Hello,

Thank you for your helpful package. I followed the tutorial successfully https://www.opendronemap.org/fieldimager/ until I got to section 8 Evaluating the object area percentage. 

For this step/image I was able to get the black and white image like on the right but I could not figure out how to get the percentage number as shown in the tutorial. How do you get the percentage number?

On the next image, I was able to remove the background color with a vegetation index but I could not figure out the last step, the seed color %. Could you help explain how you detected the different colors and counted the percent of each color? Also, why is total = 38% instead of 100%?


Thank you!
Hannah

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Color %
parts:
Hi Hannah,

Thank you for asking us. Answering the first question, you can plot the values using  EX1.Canopy$areaPorcent (where 0.1=10%).

Detecting different colors depends on testing different indices or looking in the literature to find formulas/equations or a combination of RGB information to specifically identify what you are looking for. Is that make sense?

 

 “Total = 38% instead of 100%” = The entire image (ear + background are 100%) from that 38% of the pixels are part of the ears. Is that make sense too?

 

Hope it helps...!

 

All the best,

Filipe
